_comment: F-16A Block 10/15 Level-1 inputs. L1 is statistical/type-based: only classification strings/scalars, no planform dimensions (those first appear at L2). Read by F16GeomL1 (.geometry) and F16AeroL1 (.aerodynamics).

geometry._src: aircraft_category selects Roskam Vol. I Table 3.5 (S_wet) / Raymer 6th Table 6.3 (L_fus) / Raymer 7th Table 4.1 (AR_eq, dogfighter row) regressions. M_max = Brandt Main-tab aircraft.Mmax.

aerodynamics._src: aircraft_type selects the fighter Roskam CLmax row + the Mattingly fighter curves. design_type='uncambered' sets K2=0 (Mattingly AED 2nd ed. Sec. 2.3.1). curve selects the 'Current' technology arrays (Mattingly Figs. 2.10/2.11).

cd0_curve._comment: PLACEHOLDER Mattingly AED 2nd ed. Fig. 2.10 CD0(M), fighter. From 5 AAF worked points (mattingly_data.md PART 9); TODO replace with the digitized figure. Future = copy of Current (no Future curve in repo).

k1_curve._comment: PLACEHOLDER Mattingly AED 2nd ed. Fig. 2.11 K1(M), fighter. From 5 AAF worked points (mattingly_data.md PART 9); TODO replace with the digitized figure. Future = copy of Current (no Future curve in repo).
